title: Anatomy of a Whisker's Soul - Rattle Tooth
description: Anatomy of a Whisker's Soul - Rattle Tooth — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul in Rattle Tooth's Revenge in The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section off of Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag to collect Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel then return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Anatomy of a Whisker's Soul - Sissirat

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul in Rattle Tooth's Revenge in The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section off of Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag to collect Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel then return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Excellent! The Townston Alchemical Association has finally found a way to reverse Ratsputin's soul capturing shenanigans. When the Vengeful Soul is vanquished it should crystallize to restore its power. We need this crystal! Since you have already fought this menace I want you to be the one to get the Soul crystal from Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul.

Run to Rattle Tooth's Revenge located in The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section off of Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag. When you get there destroy Rattle Tooth's Ghost and then Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul. When you finally destroy Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Soul, Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel should drop. Collect Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel then return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

You have the Soul? Wonderful. I wonder why we need the Townston Alchemical Association to tell us about the crystal...oh well. Here is something shiny.

Objectives:

  • Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel ×1

Client level range: 81–100
